		Dataset Summary
	

Documents from the Royal Danish Library published between 1750 and 1930. 
The dataset has each page of each document in image and text format. The text was extracted with OCR.
The documents (books of various genres) were obtained from the library. The dataset was assembled to make these public domain Danish texts more accessible.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chcaa/kb-books.
